    About this deck

    This deck uses your uploaded microscope photos. The front shows only the image for spotting practice. The back gives the identification plus key points used to identify the slide.
    Some photos are low-magnification or slightly blurred, so a few cards are marked by the best matching histological identification based on visible features.
